scope: PHASE 1 HD Cleanup (docs/requirements/PHASE1_DESIGN_SPEC.md): P1 TooltipBase horizontal placement bug (L17 else branch polluted .x with position_offset.y -> .x); P2 MutationTierXP inline StyleBoxFlat refinement (fg Arcane Accent #79D98B + Surface 1 border + radius 4, bg Surface 2 + Normal Border + radius 4, GUI.tscn); P3 ProgressBar global fg #FF0000 -> Secondary Text #9DA9B5 (MainTheme.tres, affects StatusBar monster healthbars); P4 Button pressed/disabled StyleBoxFlat variants (insert id=40 pressed Elevated Surface + Highlight Border + content margin 11/9, id=41 disabled Background Deep + Normal Border, rewire Button/styles/disabled=41 pressed=40, load_steps 30->32); P5 ContextLabel DynamicFont outline_size 2 -> 1 (GUI.tscn). No layout/font-size/asset changes; layout values (rect_min_size, margins) untouched. Depends on c5-l32 (full zh_CN chain) so the candidate retains the complete Chinese chain.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: tooltips keep horizontal position_offset.x (not vertical offset) when the cursor is in the bottom half of the viewport; affects all SkillTooltip/GeneTooltip subclasses
XP bar fill uses Arcane Accent green #79D98B with 1px Surface 1 border and radius 4; the background slot uses Surface 2 with Normal Border and radius 4; height stays 12
global ProgressBar fg changes from bright red #FF0000 to neutral grey-blue #9DA9B5; only StatusBar (monster/boss healthbars) inherits it (GUI/Player healthbars override inline)
pressed buttons darken (Elevated Surface #1D2731) with a brighter Highlight Border and 1px content down-shift; disabled buttons get a low-contrast Background Deep fill with Normal Border
28px ContextLabel outline goes 2px -> 1px to match the global 1px outline convention
